messages:
Sofia Ramos: Hi all 1st day and I'm stuck on Wi-Fi. I can see 'Redwood-Staff' in networks but when I try to join it asks for a certificate and then errors. My personal wifi works fine. Any quick tips or who to ping?

max-it: hey @Sofia Ramos 1 welcome! :wave: Quick question 1 are you on mac or Windows? Also, do you get an error code on the cert prompt or just 'Cannot verify network'?

Sofia Ramos: MacBook Air M2. It shows a dialog "Install profile to join network" then fails with "Authentication error (EAP)". I clicked the link for the network profile but it downloads a .mobileconfig and Safari says can't open it.

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-13102 for Sofia Ramos (category: network). Priority: medium. Assigned to max-it. Must gather device serial and OS build.

max-it: thanks. Two quick things: 1) check Mail or Slack DM from People Ops for the onboarding network invite (it has a one-time profile). 2) Try opening the .mobileconfig from Finder (right-click > Open With > Profiles if available) or drag the file to System Settings > Profiles. If that fails, we can push the profile via our MDM.

Sofia Ramos: I found the email from People Ops but it only has a link that opens in Safari and downloads the file. There is no Profiles entry in System Settings (maybe macOS Ventura shows it differently).

oliver-peopleops: @Sofia Ramos I resent the onboarding network link and one-time token in DM. Use the Safari link, then after download, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles (search 'Profiles') and install. If it still fails, DM me and we'll escalate to IT.

Sofia Ramos: tried the new link, still prompts and then Safari says "Profile installation failed."

max-it: ok sounds like MDM or cert chain issue. Can you paste the output of `sw_vers` and the laptop serial (on the bottom of the ticket is fine)? Meanwhile, I can queue a USB-Ethernet dongle or a pre-configured Wi-Fi USB key as a fallback if you need network immediately.

Sofia Ramos: sw_vers:
ProductName: macOS
ProductVersion: 13.6.4
BuildVersion: 22G630
Serial: C02VQ0XXXXXX

it-bot: Updated ticket IT-13102 with sw_vers and serial. Added note: escalate to MDM team if mobileconfig fails.

max-it: thanks. I've attempted a remote MDM push; it shows as pending for your device. If that doesn't finish in 15 minutes, we'll send a pre-provisioned Wi-Fi key.

shipping-bot: Pre-provisioned Wi-Fi USB key available in SF stock. Preparing expedited shipment to Sofia Ramos. ETA 1-2 business days. Tracking will be posted once label is created.

Sofia Ramos: thanks everyone 1 I'll tether phone for now. Appreciate the quick support.

max-it: one more tip: if you get to office, bring the laptop to IT desk and we can stage it over wired network and confirm MDM profile. That usually clears these certificate hiccups.

Sofia Ramos: will do. I'll update IT-13102 when tethering or the key arrives. Appreciate it! :pray:
